story.head: Who blinks first?
paras: The Red Wings (7-7-3) lost 2-1 to Vegas on Thursday, and the Avalanche (9-6-2) lost 3-2 in overtime to Nashville the same night. Going in, the Wings are last in the Atlantic (20th in the NHL) and the Avalanche fourth in the Central (tied for 11th).

The Red Wings have played better than their record (.500) says: their chances are worth about .597, and their finishing has held them back. The Avalanche’s record (.588) is about what their chances are worth.

The Red Wings block more shots than almost anyone (2nd) and draw more penalties than they take (3rd). They also leave the shooting to their forwards (3rd lowest), so the Avalanche’s defensemen shoot a lot, and theirs not so much. The Avalanche ice the puck less than anyone (1st), do a lot of their shooting from distance (lowest) and play fast, open games (1st). Colorado has scored 4.00 goals a game, the second most in the league. The Red Wings’ power play against the Avalanche’s penalty killers is strength against strength.

Alex DeBrincat (7 G / 9 A / 16 P in 17 GP) leads the Red Wings in scoring, and Viktor Arvidsson (8 G / 7 A / 15 P in 17 GP) has a team-high eight goals. Nathan MacKinnon (9 G / 18 A / 27 P in 17 GP) leads the Avalanche in scoring and is fifth in the NHL, with five goals in six games against Detroit since 2023-24. Artturi Lehkonen (12 G / 5 A / 17 P in 17 GP) has a team-high twelve goals, tied for fourth in the NHL.
Daniil Tarasov (2-2-2 / .930 SV% in 5 GS) has been a rock in net for Detroit and will likely start. Mackenzie Blackwood (8-3-1 / .893 SV% in 12 GS) is in line to start for Colorado.
The Avalanche usually control more of the chances than the Red Wings do.

lean.DET: Colorado has been out-chancing opponents lately and has home-ice advantage. The Red Wings can pull it off if their power play gets going.

items.text: The Red Wings are newly without John Gibson, and have been without Marco Kasper, Dylan Larkin, Jacob Bernard-Docker and Mason Appleton for several games. Daniil Tarasov is expected to start.
Viktor Arvidsson is set to play his 700th NHL game.
With Dylan Larkin out, Emmitt Finnie took 20 faceoffs in the Red Wings’ last game. He had been taking about three a game.
Artturi Lehkonen has twelve goals on chances worth about 6.1 goals, well above what his finishing usually turns chances into. Runs like that tend to cool off.
